## Key takeaways

- **Generation is not completion.** Producing audio creates a draft; engineering
  judgment decides whether it teaches the right thing clearly.

- **Review on four fronts:** technical correctness, educational effectiveness,
  narrative clarity, and audio quality.

- **The five-dimension rubric:** Technical accuracy, Metaphor quality, Narrative
  clarity, Audio communication, Learning outcome.

- **Technical accuracy is weighted significantly.** A beautiful production that
  teaches the wrong architecture must not pass.

- **Narrative clarity** means the listener can tell who is speaking, where the
  scene occurs, what happened, and why it matters.

- **Audio quality** covers voice distinction, pronunciation, pacing, silence,
  ambience, sound levels, effects, and scene transitions.

- **Trace defects to their origin.** A wrong metaphor is fixed in `metaphor.md`,
  not in the recording. Each stage is inspectable — fix at the source.

- **Record and iterate.** Write findings to `evaluation.md`, fix the
  highest-impact defect first, re-render, and re-evaluate.

## Producing evaluation.md

Your output from this module is `evaluation.md`, completing the forward
construction of your audio drama and closing the loop back to the model.
